title: Special Sunday Sessions w/ Joe Pittenger  📱

top_liked.author: @boringdallas
top_liked.text:
This got me thinking about Winter Light by Ingmar Bergman and how the main character kept going to empty churches to preach. Now I'm wondering if his churches were empty not just because he had no faith, but because he had no love.

Thanks for the meal of wisdom, I know it…
